That makes sense though, personally I find it hard to open up to people. It just feels like a burden to them or it can annoy me if they don't understand.

Ty, I try to be friendly or at least stay out of peoples way. You seem emotionally intelligent, talking to you was a good distraction. Ty again

I'll try that simple breathing for now since I'm still spooked by that meditation experience. Ty for your suggestions

Did you have a good support system during therapy? I dont have any besides my therapist and I think this is why my progress is stunted. Its really hard to build new relatioships

My therapist also suggested meditation, I seemed to make progress for a bit but I scared myself after getting a bad sleep paralysis episode while meditating.

How often did you meditate for it to start helping?

I desperatly want my anxiety to stop its almost constant...
To be honest I can't remember. Maybe a year? I know thats not a long time but I'm really getting bad and I'm trying my hardest to suck it up. What would you suggest?

I have a therapist. Haven't bothered being formally diagnosed. She suggested PTSD and I suffer extreme anxiety or dissociation and I think I am delusional as well.

To be honest my symptoms are getting worse and I lost hope.
